name: Dark & Under
summary: Explore an Arduboy dungeon, fight monsters and recover the dragon's treasure.

notes: Reviewed 2026-11-03 under ADR 0012. Publisher tag v2.0.2 resolves to 07be2009b8c455d99e6b39ac3643b90c49e55886. Use that version's original .arduboy ZIP container; v2.0.3 offers only a raw HEX, not a supported archive. No publisher checksum exists; Store-pinned bytes trust the publisher's GitHub HTTPS download at review time. No Nursery, PortMaster or third-party emulator payload is used.

ZIP inventory: fifteen regular files, 186692 bytes: two HEX builds, info.json, banner.png and eleven screenshots. No links, special entries, duplicate names or unsafe paths. The main Dark-And-Under.hex SHA-256 is 46df766280e4d027c149f54fc138779955ec10a0aa79fafa82ef32c17c9c6a9b. Retain all bytes, attribution and screenshots. Map the alternate Devkit HEX to support/Dark-And-Under-Devkit.hex.txt so KNULLI does not scan the wrong hardware build as a second game.

Garage Collective publishes the whole project under BSD-3-Clause, with code by Simon Holmes and art by Cyril Guichard. No commercial game data or BIOS is required. The release lacks the licence file, so the publisher's notice is reproduced below in the signed catalogue and installed-state manifest.

KNULLI distribution ab3a6809286b3cff1648fb8c96a0200bc869beb6 declares the arduboy system, HEX input and firmware Arduous 2273b485628790a2ce954941341b5b071c3fb30e. Require RetroArch and /usr/lib/libretro/arduous_libretro.so. Core RetroPad input, EEPROM save RAM and serialization are reviewed source behavior, not physical controls or completed in-game save/load evidence. Host AArch64/glibc does not describe the ROM CPU.

Store writes only /userdata/roms/arduboy/DarkAndUnder, its exact entry in /userdata/roms/arduboy/gamelist.xml, and normal Store state. KNULLI configgen directs savefiles/states to /userdata/saves/arduboy. No shared save, emulator setting, firmware or PortMaster file is Store-owned. Runtime-created local fallback files are unowned and survive Repair/removal. Close the game before operations. No runtime network client, downloader or updater is present. This is an experimental package without exact-device evidence.
